Bill.BriefDescription: Clarifying which law governs when homeowners' association provisions conflict.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to resolving conflicts between the statutes andgoverning documents of homeowners' associations; and amending RCW64.38.005.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 64.38.005 and 1995 c 283 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The intent of this chapter is to provide consistent lawsregarding the formation and legal administration of homeowners'associations. (2)(a) The legislature finds that there is a need to clarify bothhow the laws governing homeowners' associations interact and which bodyof law governs in the event of a conflict between statutes and thegoverning documents. (b) It is the intent of the legislature that the governingdocuments control a homeowners' association, unless expressly providedotherwise in this chapter. If the governing documents are silent, thischapter controls. If this chapter is silent or a conflict exists, the p. 1 SB 6228titles under which the association was formed control: Title 23, 23B,24, or 25 RCW.
